nodes.label: Tracked beat grid for non-metronome recordings
nodes.norm_label: tracked beat grid for non-metronome recordings
nodes.rationale: A single tempo drifts on rubato recordings; grid follows Beat This! beats (comp beat F 0.634 -> 0.984). Grid toggle allows reverting since Beat This! sometimes picks wrong metrical level.

nodes.label: Playing techniques: bend, vibrato, slide (ml/inference/techniques.py)
nodes.rationale: Rule-based on per-note pitch contour, thresholds tuned on IDMT AR/FS and tested on LP. Hammer-on/pull-off not detected: attack signature indistinguishable from picked notes in GuitarSet and IDMT has no labels, so editor-only.

nodes.label: Shared Python/TypeScript fixture (tests/fixtures/music_web.json)
nodes.rationale: Web app re-implements note naming, bar numbering, TAB labels and technique shapes in TypeScript; a Python-generated fixture tested on both sides prevents divergence from music_core.

nodes.label: Demucs htdemucs_6s source separation
nodes.rationale: Off by default for guitar projects because it increases processing time; band recordings improve note F1 0.523 -> 0.847.

nodes.label: Key, meter and chord analysis (packages/music-core/analysis.py)
nodes.rationale: Re-run on note edits without re-running the model; tempo refined to note periodicity because 1% tempo error shifts grid one beat per 100 beats.

nodes.label: BTC Transformer chord recognizer (Park et al., ISMIR 2019; ml/models/btc.py)
nodes.norm_label: btc transformer chord recognizer (park et al., ismir 2019; ml/models/btc.py)
nodes.rationale: Inference-only rewrite; weights loaded after SHA-256 check. Beat-synchronous Viterbi with change penalty 1 removes one-beat jumps.

nodes.label: Chord fusion: BTC log-prob + 4 x note chroma cosine, Viterbi
nodes.norm_label: chord fusion: btc log-prob + 4 x note chroma cosine, viterbi
nodes.rationale: Top-6 BTC chords per beat stored at transcription so edits update chords while the recording still votes; weight 4 selected on players 00-03.

nodes.label: Key and key-change segmentation (segment_keys, Viterbi over 24 profiles)
nodes.norm_label: key and key-change segmentation (segment_keys, viterbi over 24 profiles)
nodes.rationale: Penalty 2 chosen over 1: penalty 1 is best on AAM but adds false modulations to 15% of single-key recordings.

nodes.label: Slash chord detection (lowest bass note per beat, E1-A3)
nodes.norm_label: slash chord detection (lowest bass note per beat, e1-a3)
nodes.rationale: Strict rule (>=2 beats, bass >=80% energy, peak on pitch axis, tuning offset) because the loose first version dropped AAM 0.928 -> 0.862; benefit unmeasurable, only shown not to harm.

nodes.label: AMT model: CNN -> BiLSTM -> onset/frame/offset heads
nodes.norm_label: amt model: cnn -> bilstm -> onset/frame/offset heads

nodes.label: Per-note pitch contour (6-harmonic salience, linear-cost Viterbi)
nodes.norm_label: per-note pitch contour (6-harmonic salience, linear-cost viterbi)
nodes.rationale: Linear jump cost on purpose: quadratic cost split jumps into small steps producing bend-like ramps.

nodes.label: pYIN pitch tracker (librosa)
nodes.rationale: Kept over CREPE (0.63) and PESTO (0.64): pYIN 0.67 note F1; CREPE only better on layered/effected vocals, not worth an 89 MB model.

nodes.label: Voice -> guitar mode (sing/hum/whistle to TAB, ml/inference/voice.py)
nodes.norm_label: voice -> guitar mode (sing/hum/whistle to tab, ml/inference/voice.py)
nodes.rationale: No trained model: pitch tracking, personal tuning offset, segmentation on 200 ms context pitch change >= 0.7 semitone, octave transposition to guitar range.

nodes.label: Tab optimizer (Viterbi minimum-cost fingering path)
nodes.rationale: Core design decision: the ML model detects notes, an algorithmic cost-based system (packages/music-core/tab.py) picks string/fret. Cost = hand position vs preferred fret + open strings + chord span + stretch, plus position/string changes between events. Weights grid-searched on GuitarSet val (scripts/tune_tab.py); string/fret accuracy 0.575 -> 0.717.

nodes.label: EGDB electric guitar dataset
nodes.rationale: Labels carry quantized tablature timing, so EGDB originally only trained the tab model; RealData clips excluded (model outputs, not references).

nodes.label: Simulated rooms and codecs augmentation (pyroomacoustics, Opus/AAC/MP3)
nodes.norm_label: simulated rooms and codecs augmentation (pyroomacoustics, opus/aac/mp3)
nodes.rationale: Alone (V10a) it did not help real room recordings: acoustic guitar in a room does not resemble an electric amp in a room.

nodes.label: Tab head model (learns string/fret directly)
nodes.rationale: Very good at position choice but its shared layers drift from pitch detection, so it is used as a second model rather than the only one.

nodes.label: V10 notes model (default; rooms + aligned EGDB)
nodes.norm_label: v10 notes model (default; rooms + aligned egdb)
nodes.rationale: Chosen as default because its 2-3 point gain on real room-mic recordings (Guitar-TECHS) outweighs a 0.3-0.6 point loss on simulated conditions.

nodes.label: V9 notes model (range extended down to C2)
nodes.norm_label: v9 notes model (range extended down to c2)

nodes.label: EGDB label alignment to V9 onsets (scripts/align_egdb.py)
nodes.norm_label: egdb label alignment to v9 onsets (scripts/align_egdb.py)
nodes.rationale: Each label moved to V9's onset on same pitch within +/-60 ms (80% moved, median 13 ms); 9 mismatched clips dropped. CQT energy-rise alignment was tried first and failed (labels shifted ~15 ms early for bass notes).

nodes.label: Tab head remap to standard-tuning classes for other tunings
nodes.norm_label: tab head remap to standard-tuning classes for other tunings
nodes.rationale: Tab model trained only on standard tuning recognizes strings by pitches heard; asking which standard-tuning class a pitch would fall in raised one-step-down accuracy 65% -> 93%.

nodes.label: Notes model + tab model pairing (-log p term in optimizer cost)
nodes.norm_label: notes model + tab model pairing (-log p term in optimizer cost)
nodes.rationale: Notes from MODEL_CHECKPOINT, string/fret probabilities from MODEL_TAB_CHECKPOINT; model guides, optimizer keeps chords playable and hand movement low. Best result: note F1 0.900, string/fret 0.95, fully correct 0.81.

nodes.label: Guitar-TECHS dataset
nodes.rationale: MIDI offset up to 65 ms vs DI; labels aligned to DI onset envelope then cross-correlated per recording.

nodes.label: Offline augmentation (pitch shift, tempo, noise, reverb, overdrive, distortion, echo, phone, room)
nodes.norm_label: offline augmentation (pitch shift, tempo, noise, reverb, overdrive, distortion, echo, phone, room)

nodes.label: Player-based split (train 00-03, val 04, test 05)
nodes.rationale: Split by player rather than random frames so the model is tested against a guitarist never seen in training; no augmentation on val/test.

nodes.label: Strum rhythm pattern (packages/music-core/rhythm.py, pendulum rule)
nodes.rationale: Strums from transcription (>=2 notes within 60 ms) since direct audio onsets were too noisy; directions suggested by pendulum rule (78% correct), not heard.
